[Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge)

## Appearance

Lavendar Lewis is a little lady with snow-white, gray hair that is thick, beautifully wavy, and carefully arranged in becoming puffs and coils. Despite her white hair, she possesses a fresh, almost girlish face featuring pretty, pink-cheeked skin with dimples and sweet lips. Her large, soft, wood-brown eyes have a sweet expression and contain little golden glints.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P25](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0025), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058)_

## Personality

Lavendar Lewis is an imaginative individual who relies on pretending to help cope with life. By her own admission, she can be dreadfully sulky, yet she also remains deeply rebellious about the process of aging.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## History

Miss Lavendar Lewis, who was named after lavender by her father, previously broke off her engagement to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) after a foolish quarrel when they were young. Years later, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) stumbled upon her home, [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where Miss Lavendar entertained them with tea. She later recounted her past romance to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and was introduced to Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), with whom she formed an immediate bond over their shared imaginary dream-people. After experiencing a period of unusual despondency, she reunited with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) when he visited her home. Their rekindled romance culminated in a joyful wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), after which she departed with her new husband.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), +17 more_

## Quotes

> "But oh, won’t you stay and have tea with me? Please, do. Mr. Kimball’s will have tea over before you get there. And Charlotta the Fourth and I will be so glad to have you."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)

> "to believe I’m old. Now, who are you . . . just for convenience’ sake? Diana Barry? And Anne Shirley? May I pretend that I’ve known you for a hundred years and call you Anne and Diana right away?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062)

> "I love them myself. They are very good company . . . with a little pretending. On calm evenings Charlotta the Fourth and I often sit out here and amuse ourselves with them. Charlotta, take back the horn and hang it carefully in its place."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074)

> "It gave me a shock to hear about Stephen’s son that first day you were here, Anne. I’ve never been able to mention him to you since, but I’ve wanted to know all about him. What sort of a boy is he?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P21](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0021)

> "Oh, I’m not so old as I thought . . . and I don’t need a single blue pill! Girls, when you come back with your strawberries we’ll have tea out here under the silver poplar. I’ll have it all ready for you with home-grown cream."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P36](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--lavendar-lewis.md)

Miss Lavendar Lewis and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) developed a warm friendship after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lost her way in the woods and stumbled upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Over visits spent sharing tea, confidences, and candy, Miss Lavendar opened up to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her past romance with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to later introduce Stephen's son to her.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +11 more_

- Friend of — visiting friends who share affection and confidences  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P34](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0034)</sub>

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta the Fourth serves as Miss Lavendar's young helper and maid at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Beyond her household duties, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) demonstrates deep care for her employer, voicing concern to visitors when Miss Lavendar seems unusually despondent and helping prepare the household for special guests.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +22 more_

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) became a welcome guest at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) after accidentally discovering it alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) while lost in the woods. Miss Lavendar hosted [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) for tea, and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) later returned to help prepare the stone house for Miss Lavendar's wedding.
